recipes.name: Creamy & Rich London Fog
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the milk, tea, maple syrup, and cinnamon. Whisk continuously until the milk starts to simmer, then stir in the vanilla and remove from the heat.
Cover and allow to steep for 1 to 2 minutes further for a stronger tea flavour. Then strain the tea into mugs and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium .
